title: Vesthon Marijakin: first confrontation
summary: Interrupt Vesthon’s first attempt to seize Hsagra’s spirit.
overview: Interrupt Vesthon’s first attempt to seize Hsagra’s spirit.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Vesthon begins a short ritual scene and calls mercenary guards into the area. Prepare for the guards as the dialogue progresses.
Drive Vesthon to 20% health to break the confrontation. He is replaced by a retreating form and Hsagra’s shade is released.
The hostile form has a three-minute despawn timer, so establish combat promptly after the ritual begins.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
